section_roles.name: intro
section_roles.definition: Track opening, establishing groove elements gradually
section_roles.musical_function: Establish rhythmic and tonal foundation; often sparse to moderate energy
typical_confusions: Can resemble a short build or sparse groove
section_roles.must_not_derive: Intro does not mean always first section; not all first sections are intro

section_roles.name: groove
section_roles.definition: Stable, repeating main rhythmic/low-end section (core dancefloor material)
section_roles.musical_function: Sustained functional dance section with stable rhythm and low-end presence
typical_confusions: Can be confused with drop if energy is high; with build if stability is not yet established
section_roles.must_not_derive: Groove does not mean only 4/4; not all stable sections are groove

section_roles.name: build
section_roles.definition: Rising tension, increasing energy/onset density/spectral brightness toward a drop
section_roles.musical_function: Tension-builder leading into a functional climax
typical_confusions: Can resemble late intro or early drop if transition is sharp
section_roles.must_not_derive: Build does not always mean 8/16 bars; not all rising sections are build

section_roles.name: drop
section_roles.definition: High-energy climax, full low-end + rhythmic density, functional peak
section_roles.musical_function: Functional peak section with maximum energy, low-end, and rhythmic density
typical_confusions: Can resemble high-energy groove; boundary with following breakdown/groove can be ambiguous
section_roles.must_not_derive: Drop is a section, not a single event; drop_onset is the entry event, drop is the section

section_roles.name: breakdown
section_roles.definition: Reduced energy, textural/timbral focus, rhythmic suspension
section_roles.musical_function: Contrast section with reduced rhythmic drive, often textural or melodic focus
typical_confusions: Can resemble sparse intro or outro; timbral shift without energy drop is ambiguous
section_roles.must_not_derive: Breakdown does not always mean quiet; not all low-energy sections are breakdown

section_roles.name: outro
section_roles.definition: Track closing, energy/element reduction toward end
section_roles.musical_function: Wind-down section reducing elements toward track end
typical_confusions: Can resemble late breakdown or fading groove
section_roles.must_not_derive: Outro does not always mean final section; not all final sections are outro

section_roles.name: unknown
section_roles.definition: Valid, normal result — evidence is missing, weak, contradictory, or outside vocabulary
section_roles.musical_function: Explicitly represents insufficient or ambiguous evidence for any specific role
typical_confusions: Default when no role reaches sufficient evidence; not an error
section_roles.must_not_derive: Unknown is not a failure; not a placeholder for 'could not decide'; no dummy confidence needed

boundary_events.name: drop_onset
boundary_events.definition: Entry into a drop section at a specific neutral boundary
boundary_events.musical_meaning: The moment the drop hits — sharp energy/timbre/spectral rise
boundary_events.relation_to_section_roles: Not a section role. Emitted at a boundary between sections. The section after this boundary is drop. A drop section can exist without a detected drop_onset (e.g., gradual entry).

deferred_terms.decision: Not a core section role in v1
deferred_terms.reasoning: Transition is a relational property between two sections (e.g., build->drop, drop->breakdown), not a standalone functional section with a stable musical definition in Techno. Its duration, signal profile, and boundaries are inconsistent across tracks.
deferred_terms.modeling_alternative: Transition character is captured by boundary events (drop_onset at build->drop), neighbor deltas and novelty at boundaries (from #239), and role sequence in the Arrangement Map (e.g., build followed by drop).
deferred_terms.future: If a later pilot (#242) reveals a consistent, classifiable transition section with distinct signals, it may be added in v2 with a new schema version.

conditions: Evidence is contradictory (positive and negative signals for multiple roles)
Evidence is weak (no role reaches track-relative threshold)
Section falls outside the seven-role vocabulary
unknown_policy.outcome: Arrangement Map emits role: "unknown" with evidence_completeness accounting for why
unknown_policy.manual_override: Per #241, manual override applies with history preserved

arrangement_role_layer.emits: Section roles + boundary events from this vocabulary

rules: Boundary confidence and role confidence stay separate
A strong neutral boundary can still have role unknown
A strong role hint must not create a boundary
StructureV1 never emits roles or events
Arrangement Map never moves neutral boundaries
drop_onset references a neutral boundary position; it does not create one
A drop section can exist without a drop_onset event (gradual entry)
A drop_onset event can exist without a following drop role if evidence is contradictory (event emits with status: partial)

forbidden: fixed role cutoffs before private pilot evidence
invented confidence when a signal is missing
allowed_normalization: local median and MAD robust z-score
relative share inside the same track
rolling 4 bar, 8 bar, and 16 bar trend

non_goals_v1: No classification rules, thresholds, or weights
No CLAP, stem, or All-In-One label requirements
